uncited: **Scale Spatial Coordinates:** Multiply the unit texture coordinates by `noiseScale` to set the base spatial frequency.
**Construct 4D Position:** Initialize the noise position with the scaled coordinates.
Set the fourth dimension ($w$) to `time` to enable 4D noise evaluation.
**Apply Vertical Flow Offset:** Offset the vertical axis ($y$) by $-\text{time}$ to create an upward flow effect.
**Add Instance Offset:** Add the `instanceOffset` to the spatial components ($x, y, z$) to ensure each fire instance has a unique noise pattern.
**Calculate Turbulence Kernel:** Compute a kernel value $f(\text{tex}_z)$ using the stability factor and the square root of the height ($z$).
**Apply Turbulence to Position:** Multiply the turbulence value by the kernel and add it to the vertical component of the texture lookup position.
This step modifies the sampling position based on local noise density.
- **When to use:** Procedural fire, smoke, or terrain where spatial continuity and animation are required.
- **When not to use:** Static 2D texturing or when instance uniqueness is not needed.
